claims.evidence: Witness report identifies a red-and-black stationary indoor cycling/exercise bike by type, but no clear brand/model text is readable in the photo.

risks.risk: Whether the bike is fully working (resistance/adjustment, smooth pedaling, noise, and console/display function).
risks.proof: A short video of a full test: power on (if it has a console), adjust resistance through all levels, and pedal for 1–2 minutes showing smooth motion and no unusual grinding/squeaking.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully tested/possibly needing service (worst-case: resistance or console may be faulty).

risks.risk: Mechanical wear or damage (pedals/cranks, belt/chain condition, wobble, frame straightness).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the drive area (belt/chain and tensioner/guards) plus a side-angle clip showing the flywheel area and a gentle rocking test of the frame while stationary.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with unknown wear (worst-case: drive system may be worn and/or frame may have minor wobble).

risks.risk: Corrosion/rust or structural issues not visible in the single photo angle.
risks.proof: Photos of all metal contact points and joints (base frame corners, seat post, handlebar stem, and around the flywheel housing) in good light.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially having cosmetic wear and possible light corrosion (worst-case: rust may require cleaning/parts replacement).

risks.risk: Fit/adjustability limitations (seat and handlebar adjustability range).
risks.proof: Photos or a clip showing the seat post height adjustment and handlebar adjustment positions, including the locking mechanism.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown adjustability (worst-case: limited range or worn adjustment locks).

risks.risk: Capacity mismatch (max user weight) and safety risk.
risks.proof: A photo of the capacity label/sticker or model plate (usually on the frame) showing max user weight.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown capacity (worst-case: lower-rated bike than expected).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (manual, tools, transport wheels, any included components).
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of everything included plus a check that any console/holders/guards are present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown inclusions (worst-case: missing manual/tools/parts).

risks.risk: Brand/model misrepresentation (seller may be using a generic name like 'Spinning' without matching the actual brand/model).
risks.proof: Clear photo of brand/model markings or a model plate on the frame and any console branding.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic stationary cycling bike (worst-case: cannot confirm premium brand/model).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of any brand/model plate or readable markings on the frame/console.
Send a short video test: power on (if applicable), pedal for 1–2 minutes, and show resistance changes across all levels.
Send close-ups of the drive system (belt/chain area) and a side-angle clip to check wobble.
Send photos of the seat post and handlebar adjustment locks showing full range.
Send a photo of the max user weight/capacity label (if present).
Confirm what’s included (manual, tools, transport wheels, any console parts) with a photo of all accessories.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as a stationary indoor cycling/exercise bike, so it can be priced at its worst-case used/unknown-working condition; brand/model and working status are not verifiable from the provided photo.
